attributes.name: background
attributes.description: CSS color of the drawing background, or transparent.

attributes.name: download-name
attributes.description: Filename for SVG downloads. The .svg extension is appended when missing; empty uses turtle.svg.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Drawing coordinate height as a number; also determines the SVG aspect ratio. Use a positive value for a visible drawing.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional caption displayed below the drawing.

attributes.name: replay-label
attributes.description: Text of the button that replays the drawing commands; empty uses Replay.

attributes.name: save-label
attributes.description: Text of the SVG download button; empty uses Save SVG.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a Turtle program; takes precedence over the inline tp/turtle script.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Drawing coordinate width as a number; also determines the SVG aspect ratio. Use a positive value for a visible drawing. The SVG remains responsive.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

credits.name: tp-utilities
credits.summary: Shared parsers, games and rendering utilities.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-turtle>` element implements the <tp-icon name="turtle" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Turtle functionality: turtle DSL rendering component.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | View the drawing and use the available replay and download controls. |
| Replay | Runs the drawing program again. |
| Save SVG | Saves the generated drawing as SVG. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
